headline: Trump weighs diesel export ban as refiners, states push back on $6 diesel crisis
intro: Diesel at $5/gal wholesale and $6.38 at the pump has truckers squeezed and governors scrambling — now the White House is reportedly eyeing an export ban that refiners say would backfire spectacularly.
overview: Diesel remains the epicenter of fuels-market stress: Trump is "very seriously" considering restricting U.S. diesel exports, a move AFPM and 30+ industry groups warn could spike gasoline prices even as it aims to cool diesel costs. Texas declared a diesel price emergency despite having the nation's lowest prices, while truckers nationally face margin-crushing costs that could carry political fallout. Meanwhile crude and product markets stayed choppy on Iran diplomacy headlines, and the SAF sector saw a flurry of offtake and technology deals (Uniper-Arcadia, Plug Power-Arcadia, Aether Fuels) alongside a California LCFS lawsuit over biogas incentives.

stories.title: Trump is eyeing an export ban on U.S. diesel. It could cause gas prices to soar, experts warn.
stories.summary: Trump said he is "very seriously" considering a ban on U.S. diesel exports; analysts warn the move could drive domestic gasoline prices sharply higher.

stories.title: Energy Groups Urge Trump to Reject Fuel Export Restrictions
stories.summary: More than 30 U.S. business, energy, and manufacturing groups, organized via AFPM, sent a letter urging Trump to reject fuel export restrictions.

stories.title: $6 Diesel Is Hurting Small Truckers. It Could Hurt Trump, Too.
stories.summary: Diesel prices have risen more than 80% since January, squeezing small truckers financially and creating political risk.

stories.title: Texas Declares Diesel Price Emergency—Other States Are Paying More
stories.summary: Texas Governor Greg Abbott declared a state of emergency over diesel prices even though Texas has the lowest diesel prices in the nation.

stories.title: ¿Por qué un freno a las exportaciones de diésel de EE.UU. podría golpear a la región?
stories.summary: A potential U.S. diesel export curb could hit Latin America hard, with Mexico as the top buyer and Chile and Peru highly import-dependent.

stories.title: Governors Take Action As Energy Markets Navigate Volatility
stories.summary: Energy markets sold off Tuesday as optimism over Iran diplomacy resurfaced, even amid disagreement over what talks have actually offered.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Restores Key Pipeline to Half Its Capacity
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia has restored about half the flow through its cross-country pipeline that bypasses the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: EIA USA Demand Forecast Raised for 2026, Dropped for 2027
stories.summary: EIA raised its 2026 U.S. total energy consumption forecast to 95.84 quadrillion Btu while trimming its 2027 outlook.

stories.title: Insights: Prioritizing process safety management across the refining industry (Pt. II)
stories.summary: Oil & Gas Journal's Joe Barnes outlines priorities for strengthening refinery process safety management, including audits, training, and leadership visibility.

stories.title: Kimmeridge: US shale oil reserve replacement weakens as gas remains abundant
stories.summary: Kimmeridge reports U.S. shale oil producers are struggling to replace reserves even as operational efficiency improves, with implications for future crude supply.

stories.title: Uniper Agrees Major SAF Offtake with Arcadia
stories.summary: Uniper agreed to purchase 40,000 metric tons of electro-SAF from Arcadia eFuels' Project Endor in Denmark.

stories.title: Plug Power signs 280MW electrolyser supply deal for Danish e-SAF project, with a further 1GW lined up
stories.summary: Plug Power signed a deal to supply 280 MW of electrolysers to Arcadia eFuels' Danish e-SAF project, with a further 1 GW potentially to follow, though Arcadia has yet to reach final investment decision.

stories.title: Aether Fuels successfully demonstrates 2.5 bpd Aurora™ equipment in fully integrated line producing on-spec SAF
stories.summary: Aether Fuels successfully demonstrated its 2.5 bpd Aurora integrated production line, producing on-spec sustainable aviation fuel.

stories.title: Groups File Opening Briefs in LCFS Biogas Lawsuit
stories.summary: Advocacy groups filed opening briefs in a lawsuit seeking to force California's Air Resources Board to reform LCFS rules they say incentivize factory-farm biogas.
